entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's absolute garbage and I want my money back. Now.

I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference that your product is impossible to navigate! It's so incredibly **confusing** and just plain **hard to use**. I've read the **user manual** three times and it's useless. I honestly **expected more** from a VeloFit device. This is a joke.

I understand your frustration. The interface does have many advanced features. For instance, many users find that customizing the watch face in the app first can really simplify the on-device menus. Did you have a chance to try that?

I'm not interested in a tutorial! Are you listening to me? I want to return it. It's that simple. Either you process my refund, or you get me your manager. I'm one click away from telling everyone on Twitter how awful this experience is.
My sincere apologies, sir. That won't be necessary. Let's get this sorted for you right away. I just need to pull up your order details to check the return eligibility. One moment.
Okay, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 24th, which was 12 days ago.
And? Don't tell me I'm a few days late.
Not at all, sir. Our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window, so I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.
Oh. Right. Well, fine. That's all I wanted. Go ahead and do it.

Of course. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. That usually takes 3-5 business days to reflect on your statement.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
